title: Photon Race 2 — Archee, 4K for Windows
author: Archee, PRISM
notes: NVScene 2008, 4K intro: ray and photon tracing with caustics and constructive solid geometry, all in HLSL shader model 3.0 — 192 full-screen passes a frame into four float16 render targets at once, summed by additive blending, after a precalculation of some two thousand passes; packed by Crinkler. MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9 in JavaScript; PRISM's d3d9.js translates the HLSL vertex and pixel shaders to GLSL ES and draws them with WebGL2.
